steps.title: Initialize Application Layout & Tailwind Setup
steps.description: Establish the responsive viewport structure, sidebar parameter panel, and full-screen canvas layout using Tailwind CSS v4.

steps.title: Implement HTML5 Canvas Viewport & Coordinate System
steps.description: Create the high-DPI canvas engine with bidirectional mathematical-to-pixel coordinate projection.

steps.title: Build Adaptive Grid & Ticks Renderer
steps.description: Develop dynamic gridline scaling that automatically adjusts step intervals (powers of 10, 2, 5) during pan and zoom.

steps.title: Construct Safe Mathematical Expression Evaluator
steps.description: Implement an offline parser supporting algebraic operators, trigonometric, exponential, logarithmic, and power functions.

steps.title: Develop Multi-Function Graphing Engine
steps.description: Render multiple simultaneous mathematical curves with distinct colors, stroke widths, and asymptotic discontinuity detection.

steps.title: Add Interactive Pan and Zoom Handlers
steps.description: Enable mouse dragging, wheel zoom centered at cursor, and multi-touch gestures for navigation.

steps.title: Implement Real-time Coordinate Inspection & Tangent Tool
steps.description: Provide a live crosshair hover inspector that tracks curve values, roots, and calculates numerical derivatives.

steps.title: Create Data Points & Scatter/Bar Graph Mode
steps.description: Enable custom numerical dataset entry with dynamic rendering modes including connected line, scatter dots, and vertical bars.

steps.title: Integrate Curated Mathematical Presets
steps.description: Supply instant preset configurations including Wave Interference, Polynomial Cubics, Normal Distribution, and Damped Oscillation.

steps.title: Build Viewport Metrics & Numerical Statistics Panel
steps.description: Compute and display real-time local statistics including function minima, maxima, definite integral approximation, and root tracking.

steps.title: Implement Snapshot PNG and Data Export Features
steps.description: Allow instant graph export to high-resolution PNG image and dataset export in JSON/CSV formats.

steps.title: Building graphstudio
steps.description: Perform comprehensive visual regression testing, UI polish, and finalize the GraphStudio application build.
